description: Akkudoktor Energy Optimization System, published by Akkudoktor-EOS, optimises household energy-management plans for photovoltaic generation, batteries, electric vehicles, flexible demand and time-varying electricity prices. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: Apache-2.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: EOS plans operation but does not control assets; integration with a home automation system is required. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
